description: A minified JavaScript library 'vis.js' for dynamic, browser-based visualization, including network visualization components. It encompasses utility functions, DOM utilities, dataset management, and network graph parsing, among other features.

classes.name: ViewHandler
classes.description: Class responsible for handling view transformations like fit, move, zoom, and animations within the vis-network visualization.

classes.name: NavigationHandler
classes.description: Class managing navigation controls such as pan and zoom buttons, keyboard bindings for navigation, and interaction with the network view.

classes.name: SelectionHandler
classes.description: Class managing selection and hover states for nodes and edges, including functions for selecting, deselecting, and querying current selections.

classes.name: PhysicsLayout
classes.description: Class implementing hierarchical and improved layout algorithms based on physics simulation to position nodes.

classes.name: Tooltip
classes.description: Class managing tooltip display and positioning over nodes and edges.

methods.name: moveTo
methods.description: Animates the camera or view to a specified position, scale, and center point with optional easing and duration.

methods.name: fit
methods.description: Adjusts the view to fit the specified nodes or the entire network with animation options.

methods.name: zoom
methods.description: Adjusts the zoom level of the network view by a specified scale factor centered around a point.

methods.name: getScale
methods.description: Returns the current scale of the view.

methods.name: releaseNode
methods.description: Releases the focus or lock on a specific node during animations.

methods.name: setupHierarchicalLayout
methods.description: Initializes hierarchical layout settings based on node levels and options.
